scope.outOfScope: radar != SEC => explicit NOT_APPLICABLE disposition; SEC with versioned affirmative non-applicability record => NOT_APPLICABLE

algorithm: Validate structural types, identity consistency, source authority references and provenance shape; on malformed input return INVALID_INPUT.
If SEC applicability is unresolved, candidate identity is unresolved, or the tracked-environment baseline/version/hash is missing, return UNRESOLVED.
If directExposure is TRUE, return RESOLVED/DIRECTLY_EXPOSED.
If directExposure is UNKNOWN or MISSING and no higher-specificity TRUE exists, return UNRESOLVED; do not let lower-class evidence mask unresolved direct exposure.
If directExposure is FALSE or NOT_APPLICABLE and dependencyRelationship is TRUE, return RESOLVED/DEPENDENCY_RELEVANT.
If dependencyRelationship is UNKNOWN or MISSING before a lower-specificity positive, return UNRESOLVED.
If directExposure and dependencyRelationship are each FALSE or provenance-backed NOT_APPLICABLE and ecosystemRelationship is TRUE, return RESOLVED/ECOSYSTEM_RELEVANT.
If ecosystemRelationship is UNKNOWN or MISSING, return UNRESOLVED.
If all three predicates are FALSE or provenance-backed NOT_APPLICABLE and the exact versioned baseline proves complete coverage of all tracked scopes, return RESOLVED/UNRELATED.
Otherwise return UNRESOLVED. Missing or absent matches alone never imply UNRELATED.

baseline.realValues: External runtime configuration; none invented in this candidate.

candidate.identityMapping: Exact canonical IDs; aliases only through an explicit versioned alias map. String similarity is never a match.

relationships.directExposure: TRUE only for exact candidate target match to an active direct deployment/use record and evidence that candidate applies to that tracked instance/capability.
relationships.dependencyRelationship: TRUE only for an explicit dependency graph path from a tracked root to the candidate target; direct/transitive/runtime/platform/infrastructure edges carry evidence and path.
relationships.ecosystemRelationship: TRUE only for exact membership in an explicitly tracked ecosystem with evidence.
relationships.false: requires evaluated query + complete relevant inventory/graph/catalog coverage + provenance; no-match from incomplete source is UNKNOWN.
relationships.notApplicable: requires a versioned applicability rule and basis; not equivalent to FALSE.
relationships.unknown: stale, conflicting, missing authority, unresolved identity, or incomplete relevant source facts.

gateApplicability.nonSEC: NOT_APPLICABLE deterministically; preserve incoming signal, no filter/cap.
gateApplicability.SEC: requires APPLICABLE or an explicit versioned NOT_APPLICABLE applicability record. Missing/UNKNOWN => classification UNRESOLVED and RECEIPT_ONLY. Do not use N/A as fallback.
gateApplicability.secNaCompatibility: An explicit, provenance-backed NOT_APPLICABLE disposition preserves the frozen Score 2.1 boundary behavior for securityGate=N/A.

unrelated.when: radar == SEC AND classificationResolution == RESOLVED AND securityGateClass == UNRELATED

ecosystemHigh.when: radar == SEC AND securityGateClass == ECOSYSTEM_RELEVANT AND incomingSignal == high

gateDisposition.directAndDependency: No Security Gate signal cap or hard filter; preserve signal.
gateDisposition.notApplicable: No Security Gate filter/cap; preserve signal.
gateDisposition.unresolvedClassification: RECEIPT_ONLY; no score invocation; no hard filter.
gateDisposition.unresolvedEscalation: Never creates hard filter by itself.

inputModel.candidateAffectedTechnology: canonicalId + evidenceRef; unresolved if no mapping
inputModel.candidateAffectedComponent: canonical component ID or evidence-backed TECHNOLOGY_WIDE
inputModel.securityGateClass: derived output; not accepted as unaudited input

reasonCodes.SECURITY_CLASS_UNRELATED_CONFIRMED: all scopes affirmatively excluded under complete baseline
reasonCodes.SECURITY_CLASS_INPUT_UNKNOWN: a required relationship cannot be determined
reasonCodes.SECURITY_CLASS_INPUT_MISSING: a required evaluation record is absent
reasonCodes.SECURITY_CLASS_INPUT_NOT_APPLICABLE: predicate is N/A with valid basis
reasonCodes.SECURITY_SIGNAL_CAP_APPLIED: ecosystem high with NO_ESCALATION or UNRESOLVED
reasonCodes.SECURITY_GATE_NOT_APPLICABLE: non-SEC or explicit valid N/A applicability

invalidInput.condition: identity fields conflict and cannot be reconciled
